description: This file defines the 'Break' class which implements the <break> element for a mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It includes logic to throw a specific exception to break out of loops and provides a factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: Break
classes.description: Implements the <break> element for the mini-language, providing execution logic to throw a specific exception when invoked.

classes.name: Break.BreakElementException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating a break in loop execution. It includes detailed message information including the file, method, element, and line number.

classes.name: Break.BreakFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of the Break class, following the Factory pattern.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the <break> operation by throwing a BreakElementException to signal a loop break.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <break/> element.
